readerNotes.line: Traced along the heavy ticked line: enters at the top near 5.87E, dips west to about 5.78E then runs east along about 51.0N, down the Roer past Duren to Monschau, west along about 50.4N to Stavelot, around the bulge tip near Rochefort and St. Hubert, back east south of Bastogne and along the Sauer, down the Moselle to Remich, then along the Saar past Merzig and off the east edge near 49.22N. The straight unticked line running southwest from the Saar toward St. Avold is a boundary and was left out. The line has a small break near the Moselle that I bridged. Points were sampled at even spacing along the line.
